decisions: Independent tall hatchback body and own source paint; not a palette-only substitute.
Four-view alpha family gate preserves explicit crop shifts and localized skylight/door/trim exceptions.
Observed roof is rectified from north; opposing paint/projection disagreements remain explicit.
Wheel floor rest/roll qualified separately; only neutral steering is supported.
Glass and deck UVs use bounded observed rectangles so adjacent sky/hood/fascia pixels cannot leak; this retains own palette/graphic exceptions.
End camera depths and fascia height disagree between opposite source drawings; inspect exact native and novel angles instead of assuming a universal projection.
Deck, glass and end fascia UVs are bounded own observed regions; curved corners belong to own side views. This prevents duplicate glass, bumper and roof graphics across adjoining surfaces.
Hidden geometry and source projection contradictions are explicit; normalized alpha does not establish identical unseen paint or shape.

Wheel clearance: belt and inner hood/trunk deck are above the radius-6 tire envelope; tapered end decks retain the source bumper height. Actual GLB cylinder proof covers every neutral roll angle; steering is unqualified.
limits: Affine owned UV paint is cleaned authoring, not ray-visible recovery. Own projection/coverage remains separate.
